name: SWM: The Lurking Shadow
source:
A fan-fiction visual novel that is set in the Star Wars setting.

In this episode you'll follow a young man (Kaylan is the default name) who will embark in a great adventure full of action, drama and, of course, sex.
translation:
一部以《星球大战》世界为背景的同人视觉小说。

在这一篇章中，你将跟随一名年轻男子——默认名为凯兰——踏上充满动作、戏剧冲突，以及性爱的大冒险。
